title: console first load: app-shell imports helpers from the @object-ui/plugin-chatbot root, which pulls the whole chatbot (169.6 KB gzip, 3rd-largest eager chunk) into every page load
body:
Filing gate **①**: user-visible performance defect with a named locus. `reach:` objectui's own production build of the Console, measured (below). Filed in a maintainer-directed session (`session_01FLzfC4GSjCxa5gYJky3BAg`), turning the 2026-10-23 whole-project assessment into cards. Maintainer, verbatim: 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issues」, then 「从业务角度评估合理性」. ⛔ Not a claim.

- **Reader who acts:** whichever `domain:ui` seat triage assigns. One os-dev, one PR touching `packages/plugin-chatbot` (exports and package.json) and the `app-shell` import sites.
- **Dedupe:** `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, "app-shell imports plugin-chatbot entry first load bundle size lazy" → 8 hits, none open. The nearest:
  - #8208 (closed) is the same barrel costing +7 s in one *test* file.
  - #6535 and #6681 (closed) are other eager `lazy()` views.

## Business case

- **Who pays:** every Console page load, including users who never open the chat.
- **Measurement:** objectui CI `Bundle Analysis` (run 39978481965, push to `main` at 3a73c07b3e, 2026-10-23) lists `assets/plugin-chatbot-*.js` as the **third-largest eagerly loaded chunk: 169.6 KB gzip** (611.5 KB raw). Only `vendor-objectstack` and `ui-components` are bigger. The whole eager closure is 3,242.4 KB.
- **Cost if not fixed:** about 170 KB gzip of chat UI fetched and parsed before the app renders, on every first load.

## Where

- `app-shell` imports small, side-effect-free helpers from the package root `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, in 14 non-test files on `main` (889d028944). Examples:
  - `useAgents`: `hooks/useAiSurface.ts:44`, `layout/ChatDock.tsx:32`, `layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx:40`, `console/home/HomePage.tsx:29`
  - `isBuildAgent`: `hooks/chatScope.ts:40`
  - `AI_USAGE_REFRESH_EVENT`: `hooks/useAiUsage.ts:34`
  - `publishHealthFromResponse`: `preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:30`
- The root `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx:297` does `export * from './renderer'`. The renderer registers components at module top level, and `packages/plugin-chatbot/package.json` declares no `sideEffects`. The bundler must therefore keep the whole package whenever any helper is imported.

## Done when

- The helpers `app-shell` needs come from a side-effect-free subpath of `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (for example `./core`), and no non-test `app-shell` file imports the package root.
- The chat renderers load lazily from the Console (registered lazily or behind the chat surface's own dynamic import).
- `Bundle Analysis` no longer lists `plugin-chatbot-*` among the eagerly loaded chunks, and the eager-closure ceiling is re-baselined by the measured drop in the same PR.
- Check whether `vendor-markdown` (101.8 KB eager) leaves the eager closure with it, and say so in the PR. It is not required.
